en.title: Immersive Kirtan at 360 Art Center
en.summary: An immersive kirtan event held at 360 Art Center in Chiang Mai.
en.details: An immersive Friday evening gathering at the 360 Art Center in Chiang Mai, featuring Kirtan—one of the world’s oldest living mantra meditation traditions. Participants gather inside a dome to chant sacred mantras led by spiritual practitioners rather than performers, aiming to quiet the mind and find inner peace. It is completely free to attend and suitable for both beginners and seasoned practitioners. Afterwards, guests can enjoy tea, homemade cookies, and friendly chats.
highlights: Ancient mantra chanting and meditation inside a dome
Held every Friday from 5:00 to 6:00 PM at 360 Art Center, Chiang Mai
Free to attend with no mandatory fees
Includes tea, homemade cookies, and social time after chanting

en.summary: A collaborative performance by Commde 16 and Kukrit Institute Theatre featuring interactive Khon performing arts.
en.details: This exhibition is a creative collaboration between Commde 16 and the Kukrit Institute Performing Arts Center, blending traditional Khon performance arts with contemporary themes. Visitors can experience a unique cultural showcase that reinterprets classic performance arts through a fresh lens. It is ideal for art enthusiasts, students, and anyone interested in Thai performing arts and cultural innovation. It offers a wonderful chance to witness traditional heritage presented in a modern, creative format.
